criteria.criterion: docs/decisions.md D152 Decision (1) no longer says the check scans only BRIEF.md and the term's file sources. It states that the check scans BRIEF.md, README.md, every docs/*.md and the term's file sources. Check by reading D152 (grep '^## D152').
criteria.evidence: Read docs/decisions.md lines 4111-4167. Lines 4124-4126 say: 'For each term it scans `BRIEF.md`, `README.md`, every `docs/*.md` file and the term's file sources'. The old narrower wording appears only inside the dated note 'Amended 2026-11-06: the scan first covered only `BRIEF.md` and the term's listed sources'.

criteria.criterion: No decision in docs/decisions.md states the old narrower scope. Grep for 'BRIEF.md` and the term' and 'file sources' and confirm every hit is amended or is the superseding text.
criteria.evidence: Grep for 'BRIEF.md` and the term|file sources' in the repository. In decisions.md it hits only lines 4125 (the new scope) and 4127 (the historical amendment note). D109 (lines 2533-2553) covers the structural check only and states no scan scope. The other hits are outside decisions.md and unrelated (a study review, rules.rs) or already updated (ontology.toml, CHANGELOG, ontology.rs).

criteria.criterion: D152, or a decision that supersedes it, names the root cause, which is checks of shape and of listed sources and not of every governing source. It also states the tradeoff that docs/ subfolders are scanned only if a term lists them.
criteria.evidence: Lines 4128-4130: 'The root cause was that the checks covered the file's shape and its listed sources, not every governing source. The `docs/` scan is non-recursive...'. Tradeoff, lines 4159-4160: 'Subfolders of `docs/` are scanned only if a term lists them as a source, so a governing doc there can still drift unseen.'

criteria.criterion: The two error messages in crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs now name BRIEF.md, README.md, docs/*.md and the term's file sources. Grep for 'is not BRIEF.md or one of' returns nothing.
criteria.evidence: Grep for 'is not BRIEF.md or one of' returned no match. Lines 358 and 417 now read 'is not BRIEF.md, README.md, docs/*.md or one of the term's file sources'.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the scan-scope change that names the root cause. The header comment in crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs also names it.
criteria.evidence: CHANGELOG.md line 12 onward: 'Root cause: the checks verified the file's shape and the sources an author chose to list, not each term's content against every governing source...'. The ontology.rs header has a new paragraph: 'Root cause this guards against: the checks verified the file's shape and the sources an author chose to list...'.

criteria.criterion: The scratch-root unit test fails against the old scanned_files and passes with the change. A governing doc outside the term's listed sources names a term in a sense its definition lacks, and the test requires it to be flagged. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli --test ontology.
criteria.evidence: The new test a_sense_named_in_a_governing_doc_the_term_does_not_list_is_flagged passed. It writes docs/guide.md ('* b: a second role, marked delta') and README.md ('| a | marked epsilon |'). Neither file is a listed source of either term, and the test requires both lines to be flagged with 'covers it'. The old scanned_files returned only BRIEF.md plus listed file sources, so hits would hold neither file, nothing would be flagged, and the first assert would fail. The test's second part, a sense in docs/guide.md, would also have been flagged as 'not BRIEF.md...' under the old code. That conclusion comes from reading the code; I did not edit it, since this role changes nothing.

criteria.criterion: The real-file ontology test passes on docs/ontology.toml with no new excuses. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli --test ontology. Also run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test.
criteria.evidence: I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --test ontology`: 30 passed, 0 failed, including the_real_file_claims_are_checked_against_the_sources and the_ontology_file_is_sound. Grep '^excused' in docs/ontology.toml found 0 matches, and the diff to that file only edits its header comment. fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed per Athena's record, reused from CI run 42163114507 for this commit; I did not rerun them.

summary: The candidate fixes the finding that got job 20261102-223344-sqs9 rejected. D152 Decision (1) now says the check scans BRIEF.md, README.md, every docs/*.md and the term's file sources. A dated amendment gives the root cause: the checks covered the file's shape and the sources an author listed, not every governing source. It also says the docs/ scan does not go into subfolders, and the Tradeoff repeats this. Both error messages in ontology.rs name the wider set. The CHANGELOG entry and the test file's header comment name the root cause. I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --test ontology`: all 30 tests pass. They include the new scratch-root test and the real-file test, and docs/ontology.toml has no `excused` entries. Reading the code shows the new test would fail on the old scanned_files, because docs/guide.md and README.md would never be scanned. I did not edit the code to run it that way, since this role changes nothing. fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's CI run for this commit. The change touches exactly the four expected files. The only findings are nits: a few new lines are longer than the files' usual width.
